ns2:section.sectionText: Interdisciplinary Methods in Research Computing addresses technical and soft skills in managing computer-based research. Relevant to both technical and newly technical student researchers from disciplines across campus. This course will cover data management; process management and task automation; and research project management. Topics include data organization in spreadsheets, document revision control, data visualization, robust testing strategies, and reproducibility. Meets with IS 497 IM4, ENG 498 IM, and CSE 498 IM. Restricted to Information Sciences majors until 1/14/22 by noon. INFO Minors will be able to register starting 1/11/22 by noon. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. We will not provide overrides, please wait until the course restrictions are removed. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science or Informatics or Information Sciences major(s) or minor(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
